working_title: Can Luma Light the Night Reef? | Sea Animal Adventure for Kids
story_promise: Luma follows one continuous reef route to recover three pearl lanterns before the nursery parade, asking children which unusual sea animal can help at each obstacle.

music.direction: buoyant marimba, pizzicato and soft water percussion; curious at each obstacle, warmer after each recovery, brightest only at the parade
music.effects: real restrained current, sand, shell, colour-flash shimmer and underwater light effects; never spoken sound-effect words

cast_lock.luma: one child-friendly leafy seadragon with golden-olive leaflike appendages, warm amber eyes, coral cheek freckles and one small teal woven satchel
cast_lock.gia: one slender honey-yellow garden eel with chocolate spots and large kind teal eyes, always anchored in one visible sand burrow
cast_lock.deco: one small rust-red decorator crab with cream-tipped claws, moss and one pink sponge piece attached to its shell
cast_lock.cato: one rounded turquoise cuttlefish with violet fin edge, amber W-shaped pupils and three clearly readable skin bands
cast_lock.fia: one midnight-blue flashlight fish with silver belly, round friendly eyes and two soft mint-white light organs below the eyes
cast_lock.lanterns: exactly three oval pearl lanterns on one turquoise cord; none glow until recovered and rehung

story_beats.visual: A playful current lifts the turquoise cord from the nursery arch; exactly three unlit pearl lanterns drift away while Luma reaches after them.
story_beats.narration_intent: State Luma, the three lost lanterns, the parade deadline and the route goal immediately.

story_beats.obstacle: The first lantern is hidden beyond waving seagrass where the current direction is hard to read.
story_beats.clue: This helper stays safely in a sand burrow and bends with the moving water.
story_beats.start_state: Gia stands upright; seagrass points in mixed directions; lantern is distant.
story_beats.action_state: The current bends Gia and nearby seagrass together toward one safe low route; Luma follows the indicated flow.
story_beats.end_state: Luma has lantern one clipped to the satchel; Gia returns upright in the same burrow.

story_beats.obstacle: The second lantern is concealed under one fallen pink sponge and loose moss beside the reef wall.
story_beats.clue: This helper understands camouflage because it carries living reef pieces on its shell.
story_beats.start_state: Only a faint pearl edge is visible beneath the sponge; Deco approaches.
story_beats.action_state: Deco uses both claws to lift the loose sponge clear while Luma steadies the cord.
story_beats.end_state: Luma has lanterns one and two; the sponge rests safely beside Deco, not on the lantern.

story_beats.obstacle: A dim coral fork hides which tunnel leads to the final lantern.
story_beats.clue: This helper can change skin patterns quickly to send a bright visual signal.
story_beats.start_state: Cato is calm turquoise at a two-way fork; both routes are dim.
story_beats.action_state: Cato displays three clear gold-violet-gold bands and swims toward the correct arch as Luma watches.
story_beats.end_state: The same band pattern remains visible on marker corals along the chosen route; Luma follows with two lanterns.

story_beats.obstacle: The final pearl lantern lies inside a naturally dark reef arch.
story_beats.clue: This nocturnal helper carries light beneath its eyes and can uncover a path without a torch.
story_beats.start_state: The arch is dark; only the final lantern silhouette can be seen.
story_beats.action_state: Fia opens both mint-white light organs and swims a curved path into the arch; Luma follows.
story_beats.end_state: Luma carries all three lanterns; Fia's lights reveal the clear exit.

story_beats.visual: Back at the same nursery arch, Luma and the four helpers rehang exactly three lanterns on the turquoise cord; the lanterns glow for the first time and the small sea-animal parade travels beneath them.
story_beats.narration_intent: Name the sequence of helpers, celebrate observation and teamwork, and end with one warm invitation to explore again.

quality_gates: H.264 1920x1080 at 30 fps with 48 kHz stereo AAC
full FFmpeg decode and continuous zero-gap visual timeline
one Ryan voice only, measured pacing at or below 116 WPM per line
all four helpers have independently reviewed start/action/end states
exactly three lanterns and stable cast markings throughout
no whole-frame camera drift accepted as the primary action
opening high-band energy above 12 kHz at or below -65 dB
custom thumbnail and exact encoded-master contact sheet manually reviewed
public made-for-kids upload only after every gate passes, followed by exact API and served-thumbnail readback
